scope: Both the retained front strap and released back strap use all352 original physical triangles. Whole1450-node/5486-tet teddy boundary is used; no patch omitted.
Frozen measured bear is translated with full postyaw orientation unchanged; actual probe final bag remains fixed. No physical object or production file is modified.
Strict interior handle-edge through bear-face hits prove surface crossing only in the explicitly hypothetical static pose. They do not prove native penetration or force.
No-hit is not a surface-disjointness certificate: coplanar/tangent cases and reverse-edge configurations are not exhaustively certified.
Finite point-triangle distances using vertices,edge midpoints,face centroids in both directions are upper bounds on exact surface distance. Positive values do not certify clearance.
Only bounded discrete declared route fractions are tested, not continuous handle clearance. Body contact/real grasp/native deformations need original physical gates.
